tps65131.boundsMeaning: Independent datasheet voltage extrema and 1% resistor endpoints. Not a statistical result or a transient/ripple bound. FBP/FBN errors already included; do not add the aggregate DC accuracy again.
notes: PSP/PSN are correctly grounded: power-save disabled.
ENP/ENN tied to filtered VIN: automatic startup, no independent sequencing or power-good indication.
About 1 ms soft-start current-limit ramp is not a guarantee of simultaneous settled +/-12 V rails.
R5 RC filter is conditional: fast input edges >=275 mV/us require the datasheet ferrite-bead alternative.

lp2985.capacitanceExampleMeaning: Illustrative 10% initial tolerance and 15% temperature loss, excluding aging. Requires supplier DC-bias data and ESR; not a measured capacitor guarantee.
lp2985.recommendation: Retain for restricted-range prototype after chip/MLCC checks; use an adjustable low-noise 5.25 V regulator for the revised full-range design. TPS7A49 is a candidate requiring footprint and thermal redesign, not a drop-in replacement.

dac8562t.errorBudgetMeaning: Individual explanatory contributions, not summed: full-scale, gain, offset and INL definitions overlap. Datasheet DAC tests use an unloaded output; present loading/ripple/temperature must also be validated. Calibration removes affine error, not quantization or all INL.
dac8562t.digitalPowerSequencing: All digital inputs must be <=AVDD+0.3 V absolute, within 0..AVDD for operation. Move R8/R9/R10 to regulated DAC AVDD and add power-off isolation/enable for external MCU signals.
dac8562t.porRequirement: AVDD below 0.7 V for >=1 ms to guarantee POR; an excursion between 0.7 and 2.2 V does not guarantee reset.
startupOrder: Hardware output mute asserted; MCU inputs isolated or Hi-Z until DAC AVDD is valid.
Wait for positive/negative rails and DAC AVDD to be valid and stable; do not rely on a blind 1 ms delay.
Write and update BOTH channels to 0x8000, 0x1F8000, while reference remains off.
Enable internal reference 0x380001, which also selects gain=2; optionally explicitly issue 0x020000.
Wait for the loaded reference and DAC/amp outputs to settle; verify ~2.5 V DAC, ~0 V board output.
Release output mute, then apply calibrated, limited commands and slow initial ramps.
dac8562t.clrMeaning: CLR or register reset with the reference enabled selects zero DAC code, corresponding to about -10.04 V at the current bipolar output. It is not a zero-output command.

q1Replacement.qualification: Electrical/pin replacement selected. The library footprints have different geometry names; compare actual pad/lead dimensions before retaining/replacing the existing footprint. BSW current and startup must be measured. Not silently substituted into the original project.

stm32h747Module.reference: MCU's actual VREF+ via J5. Half-reference buffered locally. Do not substitute an unrelated 3.3 V rail without recalibration.
stm32h747Module.codeScalingMeaning: First estimate using ST's nominal DOR/4095 convention. Clamp again with measured per-channel calibration and actual VREF. LSB specification uses VREF/4096.
stm32h747Module.schematicStatus: editable schematic draft, separate project; relay footprint/procurement and analog transient validation pending
stm32h747Module.sourceCableRequirement: No 50 ohm termination. ST settling/accuracy conditions use CL<=50 pF: use a source-side buffer for ordinary coax; a resistor placed only at the receiver does not isolate the MCU from the cable capacitance.
